title: Filtered-colimit comparison on every finite spectral-sequence page
statement: Let I be a small directed preordered set [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], possibly empty. Let E : I → SpectralSequence(Ab) be a functor of spectral sequences [def-sp-spectral-sequence], starting at page 1 with differential (p,q) → (p+1-r,q+r) on page r. Let E' be another such spectral sequence and v_i : E_i → E' a compatible cocone of spectral-sequence morphisms. Assume every map from colim_i E_{1,i}^{p,q} to E'_1^{p,q} with cocone equations induced by v_i is an isomorphism. Then for every integer r≥1 and bidegree (p,q), every map from colim_i E_{r,i}^{p,q} to E'_r^{p,q} satisfying the corresponding cocone equations is an isomorphism. No abutments, convergence, vanishing region or stabilization assumption is required.

source.place: Tag 0EZM (lemma-colimit-variant-complexes), proof, finite-term spectral-sequence comparison; detailed exactness input Tag 00DB and filtration induction Tag 0127

proof.text: Induct on r ≥ 1 using Int.leInduction. The base case is hpage. At the successor step form the cocone s of page-r complexes with legs (v i).hom r; the equations hv give its naturality. Each evaluated cocone is colimiting: its canonical colimit.desc is an isomorphism by the induction hypothesis, so colimit.isColimit.ofPointIso applies. HomologicalComplex.isColimitOfEval then makes s colimiting.

Apply directed_colimit_homology to the page-r complex shape and bidegree. It preserves the colimit cocone s under homology, including when I is empty. Extend its point by the target page-to-page isomorphism. The spectral-sequence pageHomologyNatIso transports the diagram to page r+1; the comm equation for every v i identifies this transported cocone with the page-(r+1) comparison cocone u. Consequently u is colimiting.

The isomorphism between the chosen colimit cocone and u has the required comparison cocone equations. colimit.hom_ext and the equations for the given φ identify φ with this isomorphism, so φ is an isomorphism. This closes the induction without convergence or abutment assumptions.

theorem spectral_sequence_finite_page_comparison
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (E : I ⥤ SpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (fun r ↦ ComplexShape.up' (⟨1 - r, r⟩ : ℤ × ℤ)) 1)
    (E' : SpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (fun r ↦ ComplexShape.up' (⟨1 - r, r⟩ : ℤ × ℤ)) 1)
    (v : ∀ i : I, E.obj i ⟶ E')
    (hv : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), E.map f ≫ v j = v i)
    (hpage : ∀ (p q : ℤ)
      (φ : colimit (E ⋙ SpectralSequence.pageFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (fun r ↦ ComplexShape.up' (⟨1 - r, r⟩ : ℤ × ℤ)) 1 1 ⋙
        HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ ⟨p, q⟩) ⟶ (E'.page 1).X ⟨p, q⟩),
      (∀ i : I, colimit.ι _ i ≫ φ = ((v i).hom 1).f ⟨p, q⟩) → IsIso φ) :
    ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (p q : ℤ)
      (φ : colimit (E ⋙ SpectralSequence.pageFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (fun r ↦ ComplexShape.up' (⟨1 - r, r⟩ : ℤ × ℤ)) 1 r hr ⋙
        HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ ⟨p, q⟩) ⟶ (E'.page r hr).X ⟨p, q⟩),
      (∀ i : I, colimit.ι _ i ≫ φ = ((v i).hom r hr).f ⟨p, q⟩) → IsIso φ
